Package com.hkust.marketplace.ui

Class TextInputs

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.ui.TextInputs
public final class TextInputs extends Object
Checks for text typed into dialogs and forms. Kept apart from the JavaFX dialogs so the rules can be unit-tested.

  • Method Details

    • dateTime

      public static Optional<LocalDateTime> dateTime(LocalDate date, String time)
      A date chosen in a date picker and a time typed next to it, as one date and time; empty if the date is missing or the time is not a time of day. The time is hours and minutes, with seconds if wanted ("14:30" or "14:30:05"), so that a borrow period of a few seconds can be entered (UC5 Special Requirement 3).

    • required

      public static Optional<String> required(String text)
      The text without surrounding spaces, or empty if nothing was typed. Used for required inputs such as a rejection or removal reason, which must not be blank (Manage Marketplace Listings Special Requirement 1; Manage All User Accounts Special Requirement 1).
